title: Trade Sales Coordinator
about_headline: Price lists, quotations and customer tiers for building materials distributors
about_bio: I have eight years in trade sales administration. I started on the sales desk of a Singapore building materials distributor, then spent four years managing its price files and quotations for contractors and hardware shops. I hold a diploma in business administration. Now independent, I help distributors replace scattered spreadsheets with one controlled price book, volume tiers and quotation templates that a sales team can use without asking me. I work in Excel and keep the files simple enough to hand over.

services.service_title: Price book and quotation set-up for distributors
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore distributors and trading companies selling to retailers or contractors. Services include consolidating price lists into one workbook, setting volume tiers and customer groups, building quotation templates, and writing a short guide for the sales team. I do not run sales campaigns or negotiate with customers.

achievements: Consolidated 1,200 product prices from 9 spreadsheets into one workbook.
Built a quotation template used by a 6-person sales team.
Cut quotation turnaround from 2 days to 4 hours.
Set up 4 customer price tiers for a timber supplier.
how_i_work: I start by collecting every price list in use and listing where they disagree. I agree the tier rules with you before building anything, then hand over a workbook with a one-page guide and a short training session for the sales team.

title: Shopfront Interior Designer
about_headline: Interior layouts and fit-out drawings for retail shops and showrooms
about_bio: I have six years in interior design for retail spaces. I began as a junior designer at a Singapore fit-out studio, then spent three years drawing layouts for shopfronts, minimarts and showrooms across the island. I hold a diploma in interior design. Now independent, I help shop owners plan shelving, counters and customer flow so a small space sells better. I produce clear layout drawings and material schedules that contractors can price and build from without further explanation.

services.service_title: Retail shop layout and fit-out drawings
services.service_detail: For small Singapore shop owners and retail chains opening or refreshing outlets. Services include measured surveys, layout plans for shelving and counters, lighting and material schedules, 3D visuals for approval, and drawings ready for contractor quotations. I do not manage construction on site or apply for regulatory approvals.

achievements: Designed layouts for 14 shop interiors under 1,000 square feet.
Reduced fit-out material cost by 12 percent through standard shelving.
Produced 3D visuals for 8 mall tenancy submissions.
Redesigned a minimart floor plan within 3 weeks.
how_i_work: I walk the space with you first and measure it myself. I send two layout options in the first week, revise one of them with your comments, and finish with drawings and a material schedule that your contractor can quote from.

title: Project Coordinator
about_headline: Planning and tracking for small teams across industries
about_bio: I have nine years in project coordination. I started as an administrator at a Singapore professional services firm, then coordinated small projects for a logistics operator and a training provider, keeping schedules, action lists and budgets on track. I hold a degree in business studies. Now independent, I help small teams that need someone to organise work, chase deliverables and keep records in order. I use plain tools, report weekly, and avoid adding process that a small team will not maintain.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore organisations running a one-off project without a dedicated coordinator. Services include setting up a project plan and task tracker, running weekly check-ins, keeping a decision and risk log, preparing status reports, and chasing deliverables from suppliers or colleagues. I do not manage budgets above agreed limits or make technical decisions.

achievements: Coordinated 6 projects of 2 to 5 months for a training provider.
Kept a 40-task office relocation plan on schedule.
Cut weekly reporting time from 5 hours to 1 hour.
Set up a task tracker adopted by 3 teams.
how_i_work: I begin with a short kickoff to agree scope, owners and dates. Each week I send a one-page status report, and I flag slippage early so you can decide before it becomes a problem.

title: Demand Planning Analyst
about_headline: Forecasting and replenishment planning for wholesalers and distributors
about_bio: I have six years in demand planning for trading businesses. I worked on the planning team of a Singapore beverage distributor, then spent three years building forecasts and reorder rules for wholesalers carrying a few thousand items. I hold a degree in business analytics. Now independent, I help distributors decide what to order, when and how much, using their own sales history. I build the model in Excel so the buyer can keep running it after I leave.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore wholesalers and distributors holding stock for retailers or food service buyers. Services include cleaning sales history, forecasting monthly demand by product group, setting reorder points and safety stock, building a buying plan workbook, and training the buyer to update it. I do not place orders or negotiate with suppliers.

achievements: Built a forecast for 800 products that cut stock-outs by 30 percent.
Set reorder points for 3 warehouses of a beverage distributor.
Reduced slow-moving stock by S$180,000 in a year.
Trained 4 buyers to maintain their own planning workbook.
how_i_work: I ask for two years of sales and stock data and check it with you before modelling. I explain every assumption in plain words and finish by training your buyer to refresh the plan each month.

title: Clinical Research Nurse Adviser
about_headline: Clinical trial site operations and nursing governance for research units
about_bio: I have fifteen years in clinical research nursing. I began on a hospital ward, moved into a research unit at a Singapore public hospital, and then ran a trial site team of eight for six years. I hold a master's degree in nursing and a clinical research certificate. Now independent, I advise research units on site staffing, consent practice and monitoring readiness. My work is judgement for the team that runs the site, not hands-on care of participants.

services.service_detail: For hospital research units and private clinics hosting clinical trials in Singapore. Services include reviewing site staffing and workload, assessing informed consent practice, preparing for sponsor monitoring and audit visits, and advising on delegation and training records. The review follows good clinical practice and local rules. I do not recruit participants or provide care.

achievements: Prepared a research unit for 3 sponsor audits with no major findings.
Reviewed consent practice across 12 trials.
Guided a team of 8 research nurses through a staffing reorganisation.
Cut protocol deviations by 35 percent in two years.
how_i_work: I begin with interviews and a sample of site files, then give you a short findings note before the full report. I advise on priorities and leave the decisions with the people who run the unit.

title: Operations Consultant
about_headline: Process and capacity reviews for service and logistics operations
about_bio: I have sixteen years in operations improvement. I started as an analyst at a Singapore warehousing operator, managed a distribution centre team of thirty, and later ran an improvement office for a regional courier network. I hold a degree in industrial engineering. Now independent, I advise managers on where work queues up, how roles overlap and which changes are worth making first. I give management a practical view of how an operation runs and what to fix.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore companies running warehousing, delivery or service operations with a team of 30 to 150. Services include mapping workflows, measuring queues and rework, reviewing roles and shift patterns, recommending changes in priority order, and presenting findings to management. I do not implement software or manage the team day to day.

achievements: Cut order cycle time by 28 percent across 2 distribution centres.
Reviewed roles for a courier hub of 120 staff.
Led a 6-month improvement programme with 9 projects.
Reduced overtime cost by S$240,000 a year.
how_i_work: I spend the first week on site watching how work moves and talking to supervisors. I report what I found with numbers, propose a short list of changes in order of value, and brief management on the trade-offs.

title: Plant Maintenance Advisor
about_headline: Maintenance strategy and reliability reviews for food and chemical plants
about_bio: I have eighteen years in plant maintenance. I started as a maintenance engineer at a Singapore chemical blending plant, became maintenance manager for a food factory, and later led reliability work for a group of four sites. I hold a degree in mechanical engineering. Now independent, I advise plant owners on maintenance planning, spare parts and downtime. My experience is in process plants and packaging lines, not in machining or tight tolerance work.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore manufacturers of food, chemicals and packaged goods. Services include reviewing maintenance schedules and breakdown records, ranking equipment by criticality, advising on spare parts stock levels, recommending a planned maintenance model, and briefing management on costs and priorities. I do not carry out repairs or supply spare parts.

achievements: Cut unplanned downtime by 40 percent at a food factory.
Led a reliability review covering 4 sites and 600 assets.
Redesigned a spare parts list and released S$350,000 of stock.
Advised 5 plant owners on maintenance budgets.
how_i_work: I read the breakdown history before I visit, then walk the plant with the maintenance team. I give management a ranked list of equipment and actions with costs, and explain the reasoning behind each ranking.

title: Manufacturing Operations Director
about_headline: Operating models and organisation design for precision manufacturers
about_bio: I have seventeen years in precision manufacturing. I started as a production engineer at a Singapore aerospace parts maker, ran a machining and quality department of sixty, and later served as operations director for a medical components firm. I hold a degree in mechanical engineering and a master's in operations management. Now independent, I advise owners on how production, planning and quality should be organised, and who should decide what. I give management clear recommendations rather than drawings.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore manufacturers of machined and moulded components. Services include reviewing how planning, production and quality interact, clarifying roles and decision rights, advising on shift and line structure, recommending changes in priority order, and presenting findings to owners. I do not manage production or select machines.

achievements: Restructured planning and quality teams of 60 staff across 3 lines.
Cut late deliveries from 22 percent to 6 percent.
Led a factory move for a medical components firm in 5 months.
Reviewed operating models for 4 manufacturers.
how_i_work: I interview people on every shift and review a month of production and quality records. I present options with their trade-offs to management, recommend one, and leave a short roadmap.

title: Licensing Contracts Specialist
about_headline: Technology and content licensing agreements for software and media owners
about_bio: I have twenty-six years in commercial contracts. I started as a legal executive at a Singapore law practice, spent a decade as in-house contracts manager for a software company, and then headed a licensing team of six at a regional media group. I hold a law degree. Now independent, I advise owners of software and content on licence terms, royalties and renewals. I read agreements closely and tell clients plainly which terms matter and which do not.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore software firms, publishers and media owners licensing their products to others. Services include reviewing licence agreements, advising on royalty and term structures, preparing negotiation notes, drafting plain-language summaries for management, and advising on renewals. I do not appear in court or file registrations.

achievements: Reviewed 150 licence agreements for a software publisher.
Advised on royalty terms worth S$2 million a year.
Led a licensing team of 6 across 4 markets.
Cut contract review time from 10 days to 4.
how_i_work: I begin with the agreements and a call to understand the commercial aim. I mark up the terms that carry risk, explain them in plain language, and give you a short note on what to ask for.

title: Trade Mark Specialist
about_headline: Trade mark searches, filings and brand protection for small businesses
about_bio: I have twenty-eight years in trade mark practice. I started as a trade mark clerk at a Singapore intellectual property firm, qualified as a trade mark agent, and spent fifteen years running a trade mark team handling filings across Asia. I hold a law degree. Now independent, I help small businesses protect names and logos, from the first search to registration and renewal. I give clear advice on risk, and I handle the paperwork myself.

services.service_title: Trade mark search and registration advice
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore businesses and startups protecting names and logos here and abroad. Services include clearance searches, advice on class selection, preparing and filing applications, responding to examiner objections, and watching for conflicting marks. I do not handle patents, designs or infringement litigation.

achievements: Filed 400 trade mark applications across 12 countries.
Overturned 25 examiner objections without hearings.
Led a brand portfolio audit covering 180 marks.
Cut renewal lapses from 9 a year to 0 for a retailer.
how_i_work: I start with a clearance search and explain the risk in plain words before you spend on filing. I keep a renewal calendar for every mark I file so nothing lapses.

title: Patent Strategy Consultant
about_headline: Patent landscapes and filing strategy for health and medical technology
about_bio: I have twenty-three years in patent work. I began as a patent examiner assistant, qualified as a patent agent at a Singapore intellectual property firm, and later led the patent strategy group of a medical technology company. I hold a degree in biomedical engineering and a master's in intellectual property law. Now independent, I help technology companies map competing patents, find room to operate and decide what to file. My background is in medical devices rather than software.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore technology companies and startups deciding what to protect and where. Services include landscape searches, freedom to operate assessments, advice on filing versus trade secrets, claim strategy notes for management, and coordinating with the filing agent. I do not draft full patent specifications or run oppositions.

achievements: Mapped 600 patent families for a diagnostics start-up.
Advised on 40 filings across 5 jurisdictions.
Cut yearly patent costs by 25 percent through portfolio pruning.
Led a freedom to operate review covering 25 patents for a device launch.
how_i_work: I agree the questions the landscape must answer before I search. I report in a short memo with a map of the patents that matter and a clear recommendation, then walk you through it.

title: Corporate Communications Writer
about_headline: Writing and editing for schools, universities and training providers
about_bio: I have twenty-nine years in communications for the education sector. I began as a newsletter editor at a Singapore school, worked for a university's communications office for two decades, and later headed content for a private education group. I hold an arts degree. Now independent, I write and edit prospectuses, parent newsletters and annual reports for schools and training providers. I know how education institutions speak to parents and staff, and I keep copy plain.

services.service_title: Writing and editing for education providers
services.service_detail: For schools, colleges and training providers in Singapore needing clear written material. Services include prospectuses and brochures, parent newsletters, annual report sections, website copy, and editing staff-written documents for tone and clarity. I do not provide legal, curriculum or technical advice, and I do not design layouts.

achievements: Edited 22 annual reports for a university group.
Wrote 8 prospectuses read by 10,000 families.
Cut newsletter production time from 3 weeks to 1.
Led a content team of 5 for 6 years.
how_i_work: I ask for past material and a short brief on your audience. I send a first draft quickly, take one round of comments from one person, and deliver the final text on time.

title: Technical Writer
about_headline: User guides and procedure documents for engineering and software teams
about_bio: I have six years in technical writing. I started as a documentation assistant at a Singapore software company, then spent four years writing user guides, release notes and internal procedures for engineering teams. I hold a degree in communications. Now independent, I help small teams turn expert knowledge into clear instructions that other people can follow. I am comfortable asking engineers questions until a procedure is clear, and I write in plain English with consistent terms.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore engineering and technology teams that need clear written instructions. Services include interviewing subject experts, writing user guides and standard operating procedures, building simple templates, and reviewing drafts with the team. I write new content from scratch. I do not copy-edit other authors' long documents or design page layouts.

achievements: Wrote 35 procedures for a 40-person engineering team.
Cut onboarding questions by 30 percent with a new user guide.
Reviewed 12 release notes for clarity each quarter.
Built a documentation template adopted by 4 teams.
how_i_work: I interview the people who know the subject and write a first draft within days. I send it to one reviewer at a time, keep a change list, and advise on how to keep the document up to date afterwards.

title: Video Editor
about_headline: Editing long-form video for corporate and training clients
about_bio: I have eight years in video post-production. I began as an assistant editor at a Singapore production house, then spent five years cutting corporate films, training series and event recaps of up to two hours. I hold a diploma in digital media. Now independent, I help organisations turn raw footage into finished videos with clean cuts, sound and captions. I work to a clear brief, keep revisions organised, and advise clients on structure and running time before I start cutting.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore companies, schools and training providers with recorded footage to turn into finished video. Services include assembling rough cuts, tightening pacing, colour and sound correction, captions and subtitles, and exporting versions for web and events. I advise on structure. I do not film, write scripts or design graphics.

achievements: Edited 60 training videos of 20 to 45 minutes each.
Cut a 2-hour conference recording into 8 clips in 5 days.
Reduced revision rounds from 4 to 2 with a storyboard review.
Advised 6 clients on running time and structure.
how_i_work: I review all the footage before the first cut and send you a short plan of structure and length. You get a rough cut, one consolidated round of comments, and a final export in the formats you need.

title: Technical Copy Editor
about_headline: Proofreading and editing of engineering and construction documents
about_bio: I have nine years in technical editing. I started as a proofreader at a Singapore construction publishing house, then spent six years copy-editing design reports, specifications and standards for engineering consultancies and developers. I hold a degree in English and a certificate in editing. Now independent, I help technical teams make long documents consistent and readable. I am careful with numbering, units and cross-references, and I query anything unclear instead of guessing.

services.service_title: Copy-editing and proofreading of technical manuals
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore engineering, architecture and construction firms producing long reports and manuals. Services include correcting language and consistency, checking headings, numbering, tables and cross-references, applying a house style, and returning tracked changes with a query list. I do not rewrite technical content or verify engineering calculations.

achievements: Edited 40 design reports of 100 to 400 pages.
Cut revision rounds from 5 to 2 for a specifications manual.
Built a style sheet now used by 3 consultancies.
Reviewed 25 tender documents for consistency before submission.
how_i_work: I ask for the style rules and any glossary first. I edit in tracked changes, keep a running query list for the authors, and return the manual in one pass with a short summary of the main fixes.

title: Annual Report Proofreader
about_headline: Proofreading and copy-editing of long financial and corporate reports
about_bio: I have six years in editorial work. I began as an editorial assistant at a Singapore financial printer, then spent four years proofreading annual reports, prospectuses and sustainability reports of up to 300 pages. I hold a degree in English literature. Now independent, I help companies tidy long documents under deadline. Most of my experience is in financial and corporate text, so I am careful about figures, tables and consistent terms, and I flag wording I do not understand.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore companies, listed or private, that publish reports, circulars or regulatory documents. Services include copy-editing for grammar and style, checking figures against source tables, harmonising terms and headings, verifying cross-references, and returning tracked changes with a query list. I do not give financial or legal advice.

achievements: Proofread 30 annual reports of up to 300 pages.
Caught 120 figure mismatches across 8 prospectuses.
Cut proofing time by 25 percent with a checklist.
Edited 14 sustainability reports within 5-day deadlines.
how_i_work: I agree the house style and turnaround first. I work through the document in two passes, language first and then figures and cross-references, and send you edits with queries listed by page.

title: Youth Sports Programme Developer
about_headline: Mentoring and coaching programmes for young people in community sport
about_bio: I have fifteen years in youth programme development. I started as a coach at a Singapore community sports club, then ran a youth sports charity's programme team for seven years, building volunteer coaching and mentoring schemes for teenagers. I hold a degree in sports science and a diploma in youth work. Now independent, I design and write the training materials, protocols and session plans that let volunteers run a youth programme safely and consistently.

services.service_title: Volunteer programme materials for youth organisations
services.service_detail: For small Singapore charities, clubs and businesses running youth programmes with volunteers. Services include writing volunteer training packs, safeguarding and conduct protocols, session plans for a full programme cycle, and simple attendance and progress trackers. I produce the materials and train the first group of volunteers. I do not provide counselling.

achievements: Wrote a coach training pack used by 90 volunteers.
Built session plans for a 16-week programme for 120 teenagers.
Raised volunteer retention from 55 percent to 78 percent.
Reviewed safeguarding practice at 6 sports clubs.
how_i_work: I begin with a short interview about who the volunteers are and how much time they have. I write the materials in plain language, test one session with volunteers, and revise the pack before handing it over.

title: Youth Outreach Worker
about_headline: Outreach and case support for out-of-school and at-risk young people
about_bio: I have fourteen years in youth work. I began as a youth worker at a Singapore community centre, then spent eight years in outreach, walking neighbourhoods at night and supporting out-of-school young people with school, work and family problems. I hold a degree in social work. Now independent, I prepare outreach plans, case notes and referral pathways for organisations that work with at-risk youth. My strength is practical outreach rather than structured volunteer programmes.

services.service_title: Youth outreach plans and case support tools
services.service_detail: For small Singapore charities and community groups working with at-risk young people. Services include writing outreach plans, case note templates and referral guides, training staff in engagement and boundary setting, and preparing monthly outreach summaries. I produce the documents and train staff. I do not run mentoring schemes or provide therapy.

achievements: Wrote outreach plans covering 5 neighbourhoods and 200 young people.
Built a referral guide for 25 agencies.
Cut case file backlog from 80 to 10 in 6 weeks.
Advised 3 charities on boundary and safety practice.
how_i_work: I spend time with your team and the young people first so the documents match real practice. I write in plain language, pilot each tool for two weeks, and adjust it before the final handover.

title: Corporate Learning Designer
about_headline: Training packs and facilitator guides for adult learners
about_bio: I have sixteen years in learning design. I started as a trainer at a Singapore training provider, then designed courses for a retail group's staff academy and later for several professional bodies. I hold a degree in education and a certificate in adult learning. Now independent, I write facilitator guides, slide decks and exercises for working adults. I am practical about what part-time learners can absorb, and I test each session with a small group before the final version.

services.service_title: Training pack design for adult learners
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore organisations that need a training course written for staff or volunteers. Services include learning needs interviews, session plans, facilitator guides, slide decks, practice exercises and short assessments. I write the pack and brief the trainer. I do not deliver courses or specialise in any one sector.

achievements: Designed 20 courses for a staff academy of 2,000 people.
Wrote facilitator guides now used by 35 trainers.
Raised course ratings from 3.9 to 4.6 out of 5.
Reviewed 10 existing courses for a professional body.
how_i_work: I interview the learners and their managers first. I draft the pack, test one session with a pilot group, revise it, and finish with a handover briefing for whoever will deliver it.

title: Attendance Systems Consultant
about_headline: Time and attendance tracking systems for factories and service teams
about_bio: I have fourteen years in workforce systems. I started as a support analyst at a Singapore payroll software vendor, then spent nine years implementing time and attendance trackers for factories, cleaning contractors and retail chains. I hold a degree in information systems. Now independent, I configure attendance and shift systems, build the reports that payroll teams need, and train supervisors to use them. My work is systems for hourly staff, not people programmes.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore employers with shift or hourly staff. Services include configuring clock-in systems and shift rules, building daily and monthly attendance reports, linking the tracker to payroll exports, and training supervisors on exceptions. I do the configuration myself. I do not design training or welfare programmes.

achievements: Configured attendance systems for 25 sites with 3,000 staff.
Built exception reports that cut payroll corrections by 40 percent.
Trained 60 supervisors in 2 weeks.
Reviewed shift rules for a cleaning contractor with 8 shift patterns.
how_i_work: I map the shift patterns and pay rules with your payroll team first. I configure the system in a test setup, run it in parallel for two weeks, and train supervisors before it goes live.

title: Passenger Experience Specialist
about_headline: Onboard service reviews and guest flow improvement for ferries and cruises
about_bio: I have fifteen years in passenger services. I started as a guest services officer at a Singapore cruise terminal, then ran onboard service for a regional ferry operator, and later set up service standards for a cruise line's Asian sailings. I hold a hospitality degree. Now independent, I review how passengers are boarded, seated and served, and I write the service flow guides crews follow. I advise managers and I also write the procedures myself.

services.service_title: Passenger service flow review and procedures
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore passenger transport and travel operators. Services include observing boarding and onboard service, interviewing crew, mapping timing and queues, recommending changes to service flow and catering loading, and writing revised procedures. I do not train crew in safety or manage operations day to day.

achievements: Cut boarding time by 20 percent across 4 ferry routes.
Wrote service standards for 12 sailings a month.
Reviewed catering logistics for a cruise line with 1,800 guests.
Raised passenger satisfaction from 72 to 85 percent.
how_i_work: I travel with the service whenever I can and interview crew away from supervisors. I report what I saw with timings, recommend changes, and write the revised service steps so crews can use them.

title: Service Recovery Consultant
about_headline: Complaint handling and service recovery for airline passenger teams
about_bio: I have eighteen years in airline customer service. I started at an airport check-in counter in Singapore, then ran a passenger relations team of twenty handling complaints, compensation and disruption messaging. I hold a degree in business and a certificate in customer experience. Now independent, I advise airlines and ground handlers on how to respond to passengers when things go wrong. My expertise is complaint handling, not service design on board.

services.service_title: Complaint handling and service recovery advisory
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized airlines, ground handlers and travel operators in Singapore. Services include reviewing complaint logs, mapping response steps, writing reply templates and escalation rules, coaching passenger relations staff, and drafting disruption scripts. I produce the templates and advise on process. I do not redesign cabin or catering service.

achievements: Cut complaint response time from 9 days to 3 days.
Wrote 40 reply templates for a passenger relations team of 20.
Reviewed 2,500 complaints to find 5 repeat causes.
Led disruption response for 3 airport incidents.
how_i_work: I read a sample of complaints before meeting the team. I map how each case is handled, recommend a few changes, and write the templates and rules so your staff can apply them straight away.

title: Business Analyst
about_headline: Data analysis and reporting for operations teams
about_bio: I have sixteen years in business analysis. I started as a data analyst at a Singapore logistics company, then worked on reporting and process projects for a telecommunications operator and a healthcare group. I hold a degree in statistics. Now independent, I help organisations make sense of operational data, define measures and build clear dashboards. I interview staff, clean the data, and present findings in simple language. I produce the reports and advise on what to act on.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore organisations with spreadsheets or system exports they cannot easily interpret. Services include defining measures, cleaning and combining data, building dashboards, reviewing findings with managers, and writing a short recommendations note. I work with the data you already have. I do not specialise in any single industry.

achievements: Built 15 dashboards used by 8 operations managers.
Cut monthly reporting time from 6 days to 1 day.
Reviewed 3 years of data to find S$400,000 in avoidable cost.
Advised on measures for a team of 45.
how_i_work: I agree two or three questions that the data must answer before I start. I show early findings at the half-way point, then deliver dashboards and a short note on what to do next.

title: Menu Development Consultant
about_headline: Menu planning and kitchen costing for restaurants and caterers
about_bio: I have eighteen years in food and beverage. I trained as a chef at a Singapore hotel, ran the kitchen of a mid-sized restaurant group's central kitchen for ten years, and now advise restaurants and caterers on menu design and food costs. I hold a diploma in culinary arts. I develop recipes and costings myself and advise owners on which dishes earn their place. My work is in kitchens and menus, not in transport or customer journeys.

services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore restaurants, cafes and caterers. Services include developing recipes and portion standards, costing dishes, analysing menu profitability, advising on pricing and menu structure, and writing recipe cards for kitchen staff. I develop and document the menu myself. I do not manage kitchens or handle licensing.

achievements: Developed 120 recipes for a central kitchen supplying 9 outlets.
Cut food cost from 38 to 31 percent for a cafe group.
Reviewed menus for 20 restaurants.
Wrote recipe cards for a team of 25 cooks.
how_i_work: I taste and cost the current menu first and sit down with the owner to see what matters. I work with your cooks to test the new dishes, then leave recipe cards and a costing sheet.

title: Retail Operations Analyst
about_headline: Operations reviews for souvenir shops, museum shops and small chains
about_bio: I have nine years in retail operations. I started as a shop supervisor at a Singapore museum retailer, then spent four years reviewing stock control, cash handling and rostering for souvenir shops and small gift chains. I hold a diploma in retail management. Now independent, I advise shop owners and supervisors on routines that are simple enough to keep. I observe the shops in person, count a sample of stock, and give clear recommendations in plain language.

services.service_title: Retail operations review for small shop groups
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore retailers and attraction shops with two to ten outlets. Services include reviewing stock counts and variances, checking till reconciliation, assessing shift rosters against footfall, observing opening and closing routines, and recommending prioritised fixes. I advise and write checklists. I do not manage shops or select point-of-sale systems.

achievements: Reviewed 14 shops across 5 retail groups.
Cut stock variance from 4.2 to 1.5 percent.
Wrote an opening and closing checklist used by 30 staff.
Advised on rosters that saved 120 labour hours a month.
how_i_work: I spend two days in each shop, including a busy period, before I recommend anything. You receive a short report with fixes ranked by effort and impact, and a checklist for supervisors.

title: Equity Research Analyst
about_headline: Stock analysis and company valuation for investors
about_bio: I have eight years in equity research. I started as a research associate at a Singapore brokerage, then spent five years covering listed consumer and industrial companies for institutional investors. I hold a degree in finance and a CFA charter. Now independent, I write stock reports and valuation notes for private investors and small funds. I advise on whether a share looks cheap or expensive and why. My work is in listed companies, not shop operations.

services.service_detail: For private investors, family offices and small funds in Singapore. Services include building financial models of listed companies, valuing shares, writing recommendation notes, comparing a company with its peers, and briefing clients on risks. I give judgement on investments. I do not manage portfolios or give personal financial planning.

achievements: Covered 25 listed companies with quarterly reports.
Wrote 60 valuation notes read by 150 clients.
